SIND PANCHAYATS (FUNCTIONS AND (﷓
SIND PANCHAYATS (FUNCTIONS AND
CONDUCT OF BUSINESS) RULES, 1980
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV‑A, 11th May, 1980]
No. OSD/ELECT/LG/65/79. In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 103 of the Sind Local Government
Ordinance, 1979, read with sub section (4) of section 40 thereof, the
Government of Sind, is pleased to make the following rules:‑----
1. These rules may be called
the Sind Panchayats (Functions and Conduct of Business) Rules, 1980.
2. In these rules unless there
is anything repugnant to the subject or
context:‑
(a) "Chairman" means
the Chairman of a Panchayat;
(b) "Member" means a
member of a Panchayat and includes the Chairman;
(c) "Meeting" means
the meeting of a Panchayat under these rules but does not include the day‑to‑day
sitting of the panchayat for the disposal of its judicial functions under the
Ordinance;
(d) "Ordinance" means the Sind Local Government
Ordinance, 1979;
(e) "Section" means a
section of the Ordinance.
3. The Mayor or Chairman of the
respective council shall administer oath of office to every member in the form
set out in the Sind Council (Oath of Office) Rules, 1979.
4. Functions of Panchayat.‑A Panchayat may, in addition to any
functions assigned to it by or under any law for the time being in force
perform all or any of the functions mentioned in the schedule to these rules.
5. Functions of Chairman.‑The: Chairman shall preside at the
meetings and perform such functions of the panchayat as may be assigned to him
by the Panchayat.
6. Meetings of the Panchayat.‑‑(l) A Panchayat shall,
for the performance of functions other than judicial functions under the
Ordinance, meet at least once in a month;
Provided that the Chairman may,
on his own motion or at the request of the majority of the members, call such
meeting at any time.
(2) At least three days notice
of a meeting shall be given to each member.
(3) The notice under sub‑rule
(2.) shall inter alia specify the
time, date and place of the meeting.
7. Quorum.‑(1) Two members including the Chairman shall
constitute quorum for a meeting.
(2) The decision of the
Panchayat, shall be expressed in terms of the opinion of the majority of the
members present and voting at a meeting and in case of equality of votes, the
Chairman shall have a second vote.
(3) No decision of the
Panchayat, shall be invalid merely on the ground that the notice of the meeting
had not been received by any member if the meeting so convened had the quorum.
8. Adjournment of a meeting.‑A
meeting, shall not be adjourned except‑
(a) for want of quorum; or
(b) for any other reason to be
recorded by the Chairman.
9. Postponement of meeting.‑A
meeting, may be postponed by the Chairman either on his own motion or
otherwise, for reasons to be recorded.
10. Records of the minutes.‑(1) The minutes of the meetings
shall be recorded and preserved in such manner as the Panchayat deems fit.
(2) The minutes of a meeting,
shall be confirmed, subject to such changes as may be proposed and accepted and
signed by the Chairman, in the next meeting.
11. Absence of the Chairman and members from meetings.‑(I) If
the Chairman, or a Member, is unable to attend a meeting, he shall duly inform
the Panchayat of his inability to attend.
(2) In the absence of the
Chairman, the meeting shall be presided by the member chosen for the purpose
from amongst the members present at the meeting.
